svg.title: Emberling Studio: from task orchestration to checkable delivery
svg.desc: A real video editing run showing four parts of Emberling: Workflow and Agent orchestration, durable execution in Trace, content review and checks, and the delivered clip. Screenshots are only cropped and scaled.
svg.text: From task orchestration to verifiable delivery
Workflow defines the fixed steps. The Agent decides selection and revisions
Decisions and tool calls persist. Tasks suspend on waits and resume
Content review rejects the first cut. The Agent revises and rechecks
